initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE hand-painted foliage CLUSTER game texture, full-color RGBA cutout on genuinely transparent background. Input image 1 is ONLY the reference for leaf grouping and art style from our wall concept, not an edit target. Paint ONE integrated hanging LEAF MASS as a useful texture unit, not a whole wall or scene, not a sheet of individual leaves and not a texture atlas.
ART DIRECTION: judge and design the entire cluster as a composed shape. The upper half is a dense asymmetrical joined canopy, with a large main lobe, a secondary lobe and two smaller supporting lobes. Below it, three unequal tapered leaf-only fingers hang down and naturally merge into the main mass. All foliage is connected through overlap. Approximate occupied silhouette is 75 percent of image width and 82 percent of height, with generous transparent margins. Around 50 to 70 small broad pointed-oval leaf suggestions make up the mass, with varied scale and direction. Leaf identities are subordinate to the larger grouping. No radial rosette, no stacked pinecone, no regular diagonal rows, no wallpaper-like repeated separate leaves.
PAINTING AND VALUE STRUCTURE: the volume belongs to the WHOLE CLUSTER. Use broad joined dark-green interior shapes, a restrained mid-green main body, and a few grouped lighter sage-green highlights toward the upper left and select outer lobes. Do not outline or facet every leaf equally; allow interior leaf edges to be lost into unified shadows. About 65 percent of the cluster has quiet merged midtones/shadows, 25 percent moderately readable overlapping leaves, and only 10 percent selectively clear edge/focal leaves. Vary the outer silhouette rhythm with big/medium/small scallops and several deliberate gaps, while keeping the mass cohesive. A calm stylized near-future garden game texture, painterly but clean and simplified, with diffuse form shading and controlled edges. This should read as convincing layered vegetation at thumbnail size, not a collage of independently shaded leaf icons. Favor desaturated sage and medium grass greens with deeper forest-green recesses, very restrained warm tips, no bright yellow scatter.
SIMPLIFICATION: LEAF BLADES ONLY. No stems, no petioles, no branches, no vines, no fine veins, no connecting strings. No photographic detail, no noisy microtexture, no shiny plastic highlights, no glossy bevels, no faceted origami diamonds, no harsh black outlines, no embossed central crease on every leaf. No detached isolated leaf confetti. No flowers or berries. Do not put a wall, floor, fake cast-shadow blob, checkerboard, white matte, labels, borders or text into the asset. True transparent pixels outside the silhouette and in its few openings, clean antialiased alpha edge with no color fringe. ONE coherent cluster painted as a single art-directed unit.
framing_edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. The supplied RGBA foliage cluster is the EDIT TARGET. Preserve the same ONE coherent hand-painted leafy group, its overall value grouping, dark joined interiors, sage-green lit lobes, and unequal downward tapered lobes. Do not redesign it into separate single-leaf assets. Fix ONLY the asset framing and clipped contour: the entire cluster must be completely contained inside the image, with at least 10 percent of canvas width and height as genuinely transparent EMPTY margin on EACH of its four sides. No leaf, tip, antialias fringe or stroke may touch or be cut by an image edge. Reframe the existing intact cluster slightly smaller and centered on a transparent canvas. Restore any tiny clipped outer leaves into clean natural tips, but add no new foliage lobes or details. True clean RGBA alpha with no white/black/checkerboard matte, no fake shadow behind it. Preserve the hand-painted grouped foliage art and simple un-veined leaves, no stems, no branches, no strings, no individual glossy bevels, no noise. No text or frame. This is an unapproved game-texture draft; preserve its painting while providing proper transparent safety margins.
status: unapproved cluster painting draft; not used in game
